title: MCP apps、应用商店与下一代软件入口：AI 客户端如何承载交互式产品
author: AI Engineer
content:
MCP apps, stores, and the next software surface

Pietro Zullo frames MCP apps as the moment where MCP servers stop being only JSON-returning backends and become interactive software surfaces inside AI clients. A model can call a tool, the MCP server can return a sandboxed iframe widget, and that widget can keep communicating with the host application. The result is not just text plus data; it is a UI that can update model-visible state, send follow-up messages, stream partial tool arguments into an interface, call other tools, and decide which information is shown only to the user versus which information is exposed back to the model.

The talk’s practical middle section shows why those primitives matter. Analytics cards, Excalidraw canvases, Remotion videos, private-information widgets, fullscreen modes, external links, and theme-aware components all become possible patterns. Zullo also emphasizes that client support varies across Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code, and others, so developers may need to return different outputs depending on whether a host can render MCP app widgets.

Distribution is the larger strategic point. ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor are described as increasingly self-serve channels where developers can submit compliant MCP servers or apps, pass tool and authentication checks, provide test prompts and screenshots, and then give users a one-click install path instead of an MCP configuration file. Zullo argues that dynamic discovery is even more important: when a user expresses intent in chat, the client can search for a connector that fits the job. If a product is present and well prepared, it can meet users at the moment they need it.

His closing claim is that AI apps are becoming browser-like surfaces. Instead of opening a dashboard, users may expect to operate products through Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, or similar clients, with connectors and widgets bringing software into the chat workflow. The recommendation is direct: ship an MCP app, because this is where more software interaction is likely to move.
aiSummary: Pietro Zullo 将 MCP apps 解释为下一代软件界面：AI 客户端可以渲染交互式组件，通过商店发现连接器，并把用户意图直接路由进产品。
oneSentenceSummary: Pietro Zullo 将 MCP apps 解释为下一代软件界面：AI 客户端可以渲染交互式组件，通过商店发现连接器，并把用户意图直接路由进产品。
summary: 这场演讲及时而务实地描绘了 MCP apps 超越普通 MCP servers 之后的形态。Pietro Zullo 说明，工具不仅可以返回 JSON，还能返回沙箱化 iframe 组件，让这些组件与宿主应用和模型通信；model-visible state、follow-up messages、streaming tool arguments、private UI output、fullscreen modes、external links、theme awareness 等基础能力，使 AI 客户端中的界面越来越接近真正的软件。更有战略价值的部分在于分发：ChatGPT、Claude 与 Cursor 的应用商店正在提供一键安装、合规审核、列表 URL，以及正在成形的动态发现机制。最终结论很清晰：产品应该把 Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor 等客户端视为类似浏览器的新软件入口，用户会越来越多地通过连接器和嵌入式 UI 来操作软件。

mainPoints.point: MCP apps 把 servers 变成交互式软件界面
mainPoints.explanation: 演讲通过展示工具可以返回沙箱化 iframe 组件，而不只是 JSON，清楚地区分了 MCP apps 与普通 MCP servers，并说明 AI 客户端内部可以直接出现可见 UI。

mainPoints.point: 这些基础能力支撑更丰富的宿主、模型与组件工作流
mainPoints.explanation: Zullo 逐一讲解了状态更新、follow-up messages、streamed tool arguments、widget-to-tool calls、private UI output、显示模式、外部链接与主题同步等能力。

mainPoints.point: 隐私边界是核心设计，而不是事后补丁
mainPoints.explanation: 演讲说明，丰富的私有数据可以展示给用户看，但只有被选择的文本，甚至完全没有敏感数据，会暴露回模型。

mainPoints.point: MCP stores 可能成为重要分发渠道
mainPoints.explanation: ChatGPT、Claude 与 Cursor 的提交流程被呈现为越来越自助化的路径，产品可以借此获得一键安装、经过审核的列表和更低摩擦的客户采用。

mainPoints.point: 动态发现会改变用户寻找软件的方式
mainPoints.explanation: 最关键的商业判断是，AI 客户端可以把用户意图匹配到注册表中的连接器，因此出现在 MCP stores 里可能带来高意图需求。

keyQuotes: 这是因为所有软件都会以这种方式被使用。
MCP servers 不再只是返回 JSON。
实际上，iframe 和宿主应用之间会发生双向通信。
模型不会看到你在 UI 中展示的数据，除非你选择让它看到。
所以，商店就像一个巨大的新分发渠道。
